g.text: Wave 4 complete: the tested grid and the new minibatch leader
Rows 1–3 keep M=5. The final row centers M=6, now the highest paired mean best validation within 4h.
6000 / 50 / 3 / 6: 71.57% paired mean at 4h, versus 70.15% for M5 and 69.18% for M10 (one seed).
M6 is bracketed by tested M5 and M10, but its environment/rollout/epoch neighborhood is not fully measured.
¹ Yellow = lower observed 4h score than M6; seed counts differ. This is not a statistical significance claim.
